ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85-90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 10-15% high-intensity (white) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity black field; high-intensity white mottling and contiguous patches concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe; distinct white circular focal point located centrally near the median notch; diffuse white speckling across the proximal region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; lower vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence, limiting precise vertex angle calculation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire visible boundary; peak-to-valley amplitudes vary significantly, with most pronounced jagged peaks on the upper lateral margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following a double-wing profile extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, high-contrast textured clusters (barnacles) located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; isolated small circular white pixel clusters (potential scars) distributed on the dark interior of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustations (barnacle colonies) present on both fluke tips, significantly altering the geometric boundary and texture of those regions.
